Your 5-month payment plan is set up, and your service will remain active as long as you make each monthly payment on time. The first payment is due within 5 business days, and the final payment is due by the end of the 5-month period, which will be on or before **October 20, 2026**. 

If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask. Have a great day!
